value: With the final trial returned to A’dal, the Tempest Key is granted. Blizzard’s attunement overview identifies it as the means of entry to the Eye, the central wing of Tempest Keep in Netherstorm. The key is an access threshold, not the battle with Kael’thas. This telling ends at the gate the trials were meant to open; the fight within belongs to another story.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Quest dialogue is transcribed from a secondary mirror of primary in-game text. No source dialogue is copied into public narration; compare to the original TBC client before review.
